scientific_integrity: Exact partition-function ratio and algebraic positive-coefficient proof; high/low-temperature asymptotics; uniform weak-defect limit with analytic remainder; 143 supplementary computations. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Zero field, \(n\ge3\), \(J>0\), \(0<r\le1\). A crossover is shown to exist for each weak seam; uniqueness is proved only locally in the small-defect logarithmic scaling window, not globally. The 1998 broad transfer-matrix specific-heat paper was available only as abstract. Full priority is not independently certified.
title: Weak-seam reversal of finite Ising-ring heat capacities
